mapper.insert: insert into medical_record(order_id, veterinarian_id, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, next_visit_date, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{veterinarianId}, #{symptoms}, #{diagnosis}, #{treatment}, #{prescription}, #{nextVisitDate}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.order_id, mr.veterinarian_id, mr.symptoms, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment, mr.prescription, mr.next_visit_date as nextVisitDate, mr.create_time as createTime, mr.update_time as updateTime, su.id as employeeID, su.real_name as employeeRealName, su.role as employeeRole FROM medical_record mr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON mr.veterinarian_id = su.id WHERE mr.order_id = #{orderId}
